obligations.ask: Attend the appointment concerning your council tax account

results.segment: An appointment concerning your council tax account has been arranged with Kelsford Borough Council for 2 April 2026 at 10.40am.
You must keep to the marked walkway from the car park.
You must not arrive more than thirty minutes early, and make a note of the dates you spent away ahead of the visit.
You must ring the bell if the desk is unattended.
You must present yourself at the desk marked Appointments and hand over the completed consent form on arrival.
An alternative date can be offered if the one above is unsuitable.
The reading taken on 27 April was used, so no estimate has been applied.
